alt: Golden-hour view of the Atoms building on a Yaba street, its glazed front under a black canopy revealing the café and glowing 3D printers, with palms, interlocking paving and a yellow danfo passing.
caption: The street front at golden hour

alt: Inside the Atoms café, a barista pours coffee at a slatted walnut bar while guests work on a laptop and a circuit board in front of a wall of glowing enclosed 3D printers.
caption: Café and the printer wall

alt: Makers solder and test circuits at long timber workbenches with blue anti-static mats, oscilloscopes and power supplies in a skylit hall.
caption: The electronics bench hall

alt: A technician in safety glasses lifts laser-cut plywood parts from a CO2 laser cutter while a colleague runs a 4x8 ft CNC router behind her.
caption: Fabrication shop, laser and CNC

alt: Two scientists in lab coats and gloves pipette samples and prepare tubes at a white lab island, with a fume hood and biosafety cabinet behind them.
caption: The shared BSL-1 wet lab

alt: A staff member with a tablet guides a visitor to a labelled parts bin in an aisle of black metal shelving filled with component bins.
caption: Finding parts in the library

alt: A pilot flies a small quadcopter inside a netted flight cage while two colleagues watch telemetry on a laptop cart.
caption: Test flight in the drone cage

alt: At Friday demo night, a presenter shows a small robotic arm on the café stage to an audience under warm string lights.
caption: Friday evening demo night

alt: Aerial dusk view of the Atoms building with solar panels on its roof and a glowing glass front, set among low-rise Yaba rooftops with danfos and kekes on the road.
caption: Aerial view of Atoms at dusk

alt: Painted dawn streetscape in Yaba with palm trees, power lines and a low building whose windows glow warm beneath a wide pale sky.
caption: Yaba at dawn

alt: Tall painted view of a Yaba street at dawn, a warmly lit low building and palms beneath a vast soft blue sky.
caption: Yaba at dawn, portrait

alt: Painted still life of a workbench at night with a soldering iron, small circuit board, solder and an enamel coffee cup under a warm lamp, a starry sky beyond the window.
caption: A late night at the bench
